profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary: Software Engineer with demonstrated success in planning, design, development, testing, and maintenance of large enterprise applications for telecom and insurance industry. Over 10 years of experience developing software and over 6 years of experience leading development teams, creating designs and architectures for highly scalable systems, working with key clients like Telefónica (#7 telecommunications company worldwide), America móvil (#1 telecommunications company in Latin America) and Televisa (#1 multimedia company in Latin America). Self-driven and enthusiastic for technology.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Part of the Azure DevOps team, responsible for developing or testing computer software applications, systems or services. Evaluate requirements, estimate development costs, design and implement the software, review the design and implementation, improve the development process, perform unit testing, communicate status, analyze risks and compromises, integrate software into a larger system, or diagnose and resolve issues. Work autonomously on specific software feature areas or components, contributing broadly to product development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led multiple software development projects for the full software development life cycle for key clients such as Telefonica, America Movil and Televisa. Improved and designed the architecture for highly scalable systems, Led teams with over 20 engineers.

• Telefonica's Phase II BSS full-stack platform. Improved the Convergent Billing Solution and Customer Relationship Management for B2C and B2B BSS full-stack platform (for over 25M customers), including invoicing, accounts receivable, debt collection, general ledger and acquisition sales solutions, reviewing business requirements and prioritize them to add new features. Designed the architecture of the full-stack platform with customer legacy systems.
• Telefonica’s BSS Transformation platform. Pioneered and enforced the prepaid national cutover strategy, involving the organization of the pilot phase, two Greenfield phases and the National Commercial Launch, implemented Risk Management strategies and successfully executed it. Part of a team of over 100 people from multiple companies, languages and cultural diversity.
• Televisa’s Promotion Center platform and Resources Web Portal platform. Application to share and store commercial videos and promotional material to customers and to broadcast to live TV. Designed and implemented the architecture for a highly scalable platform using MS Azure for the video and materials storage and encoding, successfully led a 20 people development team with an agile approach, implemented Risk Management strategy and launched both platforms concurrently.
• America Movil Split Billing platform. Billing application to allow corporate customers to buy data packages for personal use and bill them appropriately. Designed the frontend architecture for a highly scalable system, and the API to be implemented by the customer back-ends, oversaw a team of 12 software engineers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development of full stack applications, participate in the full software development life cycle, including requirements, design, development, testing, deployment and maintenance.

• Telefonica’s Club Movistar platform. Loyalty application where the customer get loyalty points for each purchase and then spend them on a catalog of products. Designed the architecture for a highly scalable system (over 25M customers), led a team of 3 jr software engineer, mentoring them and providing code reviews. Java | HTML5 | WebServices | Spring MVC | Oracle DB
• Telefonica’s Payment Management System. Implemented the business requirements and new features, led a team of 2 jr software engineers. Java | WebServices | RichFaces | Spring MVC | Hibernate | Oracle DB
• Metlife’s High Risk Issues platform. Lead developer. Java | WebServices | Struts | EJB | DB2 DB.
